title: Quick Glassy Venezuelan Peanut Casserole
description: A festive Venezuelan dish featuring peanut butter in a glassy jelly form, baked to perfection in a kadhai, this peppery casserole is a low-calorie friendly delight. It combines the richness of peanuts with the simplicity of salt-bake cooking.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large kadhai, mix together the peanut butter, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika until well combined.
In a separate bowl, dissolve the gelatin in 1 cup of water.
Add the gelatin mixture to the peanut butter mixture and stir until smooth.
Gradually add the remaining 1 cup of water to the kadhai, stirring constantly to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a boil over medium heat, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Remove the kadhai from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Pour the mixture into a baking dish and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to set.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until the edges are set and the center is still slightly jiggly.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool to room temperature.
